SELECT
FROM binance_spot_core_position t1 WHERE 1 = 1
AND t1.uid = #{criteria.uid}
AND t1.symbol = #{criteria.symbol}
AND t1.released_at IS NULL
AND t1.released_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t1.id DESC
SELECT FROM binance_spot_core_position WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id AS core_position_id, s.uid, s.symbol, s.trade_id, s.trade_time, t.price, s.remaining_qty, COALESCE(c.core_qty, 0) AS core_qty, s.remaining_qty - COALESCE(c.core_qty, 0) AS available_qty, c.locked_at, c.remark FROM binance_spot_trade_match_state s INNER JOIN binance_trade_info t ON t.id = s.trade_id LEFT JOIN binance_spot_core_position c ON c.uid = s.uid AND c.symbol = s.symbol AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.released_at IS NULL WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.symbol = #{symbol} AND s.is_buyer = 1 AND s.remaining_qty > 0 ORDER BY s.trade_time ASC, s.trade_id ASC
